name: GTG-34007
brief: Anthropic banned 16 Claude accounts tied to two linked Iranian paramilitary/domestic-security units running surveillance systems and a malicious Firefox browser extension ("al-Najm al-thāqib") used to mass-harvest identities from social networks. One unit claimed to have surveilled/profiled 6,388 Iranians in a single year via a social-network-analysis pipeline over 155,216 tweets that named 39 Iranian opposition and diaspora accounts; both units fed a shared case-management system ("Arman"). Banned for Usage Policy and Supported-Regions-Policy violations, implying access-control circumvention. Anthropic
